_note: Motivational quotes shown in daily reading reminders. Each is a Qur'anic ayah or a well-known hadith encouraging recitation of the Qur'an. Add more freely — rotation works with any count.
_audit: v8.10.0 pass: all Qur'an references (q021-q049) verified — correct surah/ayah and sound translations. Hadith are well-known and none appear fabricated, but the exact source attribution for a few is edition-dependent and worth a final scholarly confirmation before wider release: q005 (10 verses / not among the heedless — also in Ibn Hibban, Al-Hakim, Ad-Darimi), q011 (heart with no Qur'an like a ruined house — Tirmidhi, graded hasan), q017 (learner like a bag of musk — Tirmidhi/Ibn Majah), q050 (parents crowned with light — Abu Dawud/Al-Hakim, debated strength). q041 is explicitly labelled a paraphrase ('Inspired by the hadith').

quotes.text: The best among you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.
Whoever reads a letter from the Book of Allah earns a good deed, and each good deed is multiplied by ten.
Read the Qur'an, for it will come as an intercessor for its companions on the Day of Resurrection.
The one proficient in the Qur'an will be with the noble, righteous scribes (the angels).
Whoever recites ten verses in a night will not be recorded among the heedless.
The believer who recites the Qur'an is like a citron — its fragrance is sweet and its taste is good.
Keep refreshing your knowledge of the Qur'an, for it slips away faster than camels from their tethers.
No people gather to recite and study the Book of Allah but that tranquility descends and mercy envelops them.
It will be said to the companion of the Qur'an: Recite and rise, for your rank is at the last verse you recite.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ — Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi

quotes.text: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices.
The heart that contains nothing of the Qur'an is like a ruined house.
Indeed, Allah raises nations by this Book and lowers others by it.
Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.
Do not make your houses graveyards; Shaytan flees the house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited.
Whoever reads Surah Al-Kahf on Friday, a light will shine for him between the two Fridays.
Recite the Qur'an, for on the Day of Resurrection it will come as an intercessor for its people.
Learn the Qur'an and recite it; the one who learns and recites it is like a bag full of musk whose fragrance spreads everywhere.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ — Tirmidhi & Ibn Majah

quotes.text: Allah listens more attentively to a Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a beautiful voice than to anything else.
Whoever recites Surah Al-Mulk, it will intercede for him until he is forgiven.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ — Tirmidhi & Abu Dawud

quotes.text: Whoever reads Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing keeps him from Paradise but death.
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah.
Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an, and indeed, We will be its guardian.
So recite what is easy for you of the Qur'an.
And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy to remember. So is there any who will remember?
A blessed Book We have revealed to you, that they might reflect upon its verses.
Indeed, this Qur'an guides to that which is most upright.
And We send down of the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy for the believers.
When the Qur'an is recited, listen to it and pay attention, that you may receive mercy.
Those who recite the Book of Allah and establish prayer hope for a transaction that will never perish.
Will they not then ponder over the Qur'an, or are there locks upon their hearts?
And recite the Qur'an with measured, beautiful recitation.
The month of Ramadan in which was revealed the Qur'an, a guidance for the people.
Recite what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer.
Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder; so whoever wills may keep it in remembrance.
We have not sent down the Qur'an to you to cause you distress, but only as a reminder to those who fear Allah.
Had We sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled, splitting apart from the fear of Allah.
And the Messenger will say, 'O my Lord, my people abandoned this Qur'an.'
Their sides part from their beds; they call upon their Lord in fear and hope.
It is a Qur'an We revealed in stages, that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period.
So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am a clear warner to you from Him.
Recite ten verses today — a beginning is a mercy, and Allah loves the deeds done consistently, even if small.
quotes.source: Inspired by the hadith — Bukhari & Muslim

quotes.text: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if they are few.
Whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
Take up good deeds only as much as you are able, for the best deeds are those done regularly.
Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night.
Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed (by the angels).
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
Whoever recites the Qur'an, learns it, and acts upon it — his parents will be crowned with light on the Day of Judgement.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ — Al-Hakim & Abu Dawud
